profiles.label: Veo 3.1
profiles.review_note: Veo 3.1 Standard/Fast: bis zu drei Referenzbilder, Start/Endframe, Audio und Extension dokumentiert. 1080p/4K und Referenzen benötigen acht Sekunden. Extension nur Veo-Videos in 720p; API-Einstellung acht Sekunden, tatsächlicher Zuwachs sieben Sekunden. Lite ist nicht dieses Profil.
profiles.prompt_rules: Describe subject, action, scene, camera, lighting and relevant synchronized ambience. Quote exact requested dialogue; do not invent dialogue unless requested. No detached negative list. This profile targets Veo 3.1 Standard/Fast, not Lite.

ui_schema.label: Audio / dialogue direction
ui_schema.help: Optional ambience, SFX or exact quoted dialogue; Veo 3.1 generates audio natively.

t2v.prompt_rules: Describe subject, action, environment and a plausible temporal progression. One coherent shot unless the source explicitly requires a sequence.

i2v.label: Bild → Video
i2v.prompt_rules: Treat the image as the opening visual anchor. Focus on the supplied subject motion and environmental motion; camera behavior only if explicitly specified while preserving the source.

first_last.label: Anfangs- und Endframe
first_last.prompt_rules: Describe a physically coherent transition between the explicitly supplied opening and ending frames.

reference.label: Referenzbilder → Video
reference.prompt_rules: Assign the reference images ingredient roles, preserve their identities and describe the generated shot and motion.

extend.label: Video fortsetzen
extend.prompt_rules: Describe the natural continuation of the supplied clip, maintaining motion, camera direction and synchronized audio. Extend a previous Veo-generated video only. Input must be 720p and within the provider retention period. The generated continuation adds seven seconds; do not promise arbitrary source-video extension.
